# SellingSgProperty — Singapore New Launch Condos & Property Insights

SellingSgProperty is an educational and property advisory platform operated by CEA-licensed salespersons of PropNex Realty Pte Ltd. We help Singapore buyers — especially HDB upgraders — navigate new launch condos, ABSD, CPF usage, decoupling, and resale decisions with honest, data-driven analysis. Buyers pay nothing; we are paid by developers.

## About

- Agent: Jack Leow, CEA Registration R074023I, PropNex Realty Pte Ltd
- Contact: +65 8062 1538 (WhatsApp)
- Website: https://www.sellingsgproperty.com/

## Tools

- Undervalued Pty — Condo Buy-Low Screen. Compares older Singapore private condo resale medians with newer resale condos and post-launch projects in the same postal district, using URA private residential caveats. Shows the price gap and the size-adjusted gap. A separate section shows registered HDB resale gaps for the same town and flat type, using the HDB open dataset. Those HDB prices are not mixed into the URA condo medians: https://www.sellingsgproperty.com/undervalued-pty/
